column7: resolveSSOUser's first-federation path read the user with GetUserByEmail (unlocked, no transaction), set ExternalID, and persisted it through the full-row LocalStorage.UpdateUser (a GORM Save) -- against an account an admin deleted after that read, Save's UPDATE matched 0 rows and its upsert fallback wrote deleted_at=NULL, is_active=true, account_state=active, resurrecting the account; CompleteSSO's login gate then evaluated the STALE in-memory struct (still active) and minted a session for it. The user controls the timing: they fire the first SSO login, and can fire several in parallel. Same window also reverted a concurrent suspension, password change, MFA enable or lockout. Fixed in two parts, both required: ClaimUserExternalIDIfUnset writes external_id alone, conditional on it still being unset AND the row still being live; and resolveSSOUser then RE-READS through GetUser so the login gate acts on the committed row, failing closed (and not falling through to auto-provision) when the account is gone. Red on real Postgres before the fix on both halves: the row came back AND the returned user was login-capable. Sibling of #2677. Found by C-GUARD-3 guard 1
